title: Chapter 343 Masked Swordsman Vs Hammer Man
content:
Chapter 343 Masked Swordsman Vs Hammer Man

But at the same time, Wang Shuo was surprised to find that there was only a Weeping Blood Gun and thirty drops left in his backpack.

Drops of water of life and a resurrection coin.

Wang Shuo learned through the stone pillar that for the sake of fairness, no other things were allowed to be brought into this place.

Could it be...

Wang Shuo thought for a while, these things must have been brought in by Mr. Zach with his help!

In this dangerous place, without weapons and equipment, it would simply cost lives.

Being able to have weapons and equipment, as well as these two life-saving things, will undoubtedly greatly increase the chance of survival.

Wang Shuo secretly said thank you to Lord Zach.

After cheering up, Wang Shuo carefully observed the situation outside.

Beyond the mask of light is a dense jungle.

There was no sun in the sky, but the surroundings did not appear dark.

It's just that in the dense forest, the ancient trees are towering, which is very suitable for hiding an ambush.

Wang Shuo observed for a long time and found no hidden danger.

Only then did he step out of the safe zone, looking in all directions and listening in all directions. He held the Weeping Blood Gun in his hand and was very vigilant.

But not long after walking, if nothing unexpected happened, the accident happened.

A short arrow was shot from a high place. Fortunately, Wang Shuo was on high alert and discovered it in time.

He immediately blocked it with his spear, but unfortunately, he didn't block it.

Fortunately, the short arrow hit the armor and caused a spark, but did not cause any harm to Wang Shuo.

"who?"

It was quiet and there was no other sound.

It seems like someone just set a trap here.

Wang Shuo looked at his surroundings again.

Surrounded by broad-leaved forests, with thick fallen leaves beneath his feet, Wang Shuo groped forward carefully.

After walking for a while, Wang Shuo found a mechanism that had not been triggered yet.

Wang Shuo came to the tree and saw the lead and mechanism.

This trap only uses common materials in the woods. It is very concealed. However, the arrow is made of metal, which may have been quenched with poison.

Wang Shuo put away the two short arrows that might be poisoned.

Then he climbed up a big tree and prepared to observe the forest.

On the top of the treetops, Wang Shuo saw a huge black light door at the edge of the forest.

After thinking about it, he decided to go see what it was.

After walking for a while, there was the sound of fighting ahead.

Wang Shuo immediately hid his figure and slowly approached.

The two warring parties were a masked swordsman in black and a strong man holding a giant hammer.

The strong man was wrapped in a white-striped tiger skin, with his left shoulder exposed. His hair was somewhat long and spread over his shoulders in strands.

It looked like he hadn't washed his hair for a long time.

Wang Shuo used his investigative eyes to take a look.

Both are high-ranking military commanders.

The battle is quite dangerous and every move is deadly!

The black-clothed swordsman chopped Huashan with one move, leaped into the air, suddenly drew out his sword, and took the head of the strong man with the giant hammer.

But the strong man with the giant hammer did not panic. He raised the hammer with his right hand to block it, and the giant hammer with his left hand went up from bottom to top and directly hit the chest of the man in black.

From a distance, Wang Shuo seemed to hear the sound of bones breaking.

Sure enough, the man in black flew out and fell to the ground, vomiting blood from his mouth. It looked like he would not survive.

Wang Shuo felt pain just looking at it!

Just when the strong man with the giant hammer was sure of victory, he walked over and wanted to kill his opponent with one hammer.

He suddenly stopped what he was doing and took a step sideways, as if to avoid something.

Wang Shuo was wondering, could this guy have a brain problem?

A short arrow flew over from a distance.

Wang Shuo felt like shit.

There are actually people hiding in the dark who want to take advantage of the situation.

Seeing that the sneak attack failed, the ambush person appeared.

"Who am I talking about? It turns out to be the sneaky Kotaro!" The strong man with the giant hammer laughed loudly, and the two of them seemed to be at odds.
